jam.pvm.program module¶

class jam.pvm.program.Program(z, jump_table, instruction_set, offset_bitmask)[source]¶

Bases: Codable

This is the program blob which the PVM will execute.

Args:

z: Size of jump-table entries jump_table: sequence of NN, each of size z instruction_set: Sequence of instructions (U8) offset_bitmask: Bitsequence of size len(instruction_set) that defines which blob is an opcode
